The '''Memory package''' or '''Memory enhancement package''' was an implant that stimulated the [[Brain/Legends|brain]], effectively increasing the user's intelligent thought. It reinforced and augmented the synapses in the memory centers of the brain, making it possible to recall knowledge locked away in the user's mind. This was said to have been cheaper than a trip to the libraries at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
